page_topic_one_liner: SEO checklist with P0-P3 priority matrix — tracking setup, technical SEO, on-page, links, content modules, and release QA cadence
differentiator_vs_generic: This is an evidence-driven SEO audit checklist with priority tiers, NOT a generic todo app screenshot. Hero must show a P0-P3 priority board with checked rows spanning technical + GSC items — NOT an LLM chat panel or abstract checkbox wallpaper.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Priority matrix checklist board — four horizontal bands labeled P0/P1/P2/P3 (band labels as minimal UI chrome only within the visual, not extra headline text), P0 band highlighted with accent border and 3 checked rows (robots/sitemap/canonical icons as tiny glyphs), P1-P3 bands with mixed check/empty states, faint GSC coverage icon in P0 row
Secondary: monthly cadence calendar strip with recurring audit markers (dots, no dates as readable text)
Tertiary: small URL Inspection rendered-screenshot frame silhouette paired with Core Web Vitals gauge arcs (blurred scores)
anti_patterns: Generic notepad with illegible scribbles unrelated to SEO tasks
Third-party audit score widget (green/yellow/red) as hero without checklist context
